set.next_deadline: No open round as of November 8, 2026. HCD's 2025 State CDBG application portal closed April 3, 2026, and HCD has not posted a 2026 CDBG NOFA.
set.cycle_notes: Annual HCD State CDBG NOFA for non-entitlement jurisdictions. The 2025 NOFA window ran February 2 to April 3, 2026 with up to three applications and a $3,600,000 aggregate cap per jurisdiction; the County applied for the full $3,600,000 for non-housing uses (Resolution 2026-41). A 2026 NOFA date has not been announced; watch hcd.ca.gov/funding/cdbg.

reason: HCD CDBG page shows the 2025 window closed April 3, 2026 with no 2026 NOFA posted; the prior claim of an early 2027 NOFA was not supported by any page read.
